transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hey. Uh... well, I just... I can't really sit down for long. It's like I got this motor running inside me all day. If I have to sit still—like at church, or at home, or even out there in the clinic waiting room—I just feel trapped. I always gotta get up and do something. So... yeah. That's why.
Have you felt this constant need to be moving your whole life, starting back when you were a child, or is this something that has only started more recently?

Yeah... pretty much my whole life, I guess. I mean... back when I was a boy in school, the teachers were always moving my seat around. Just... I couldn't stay put. I'd talk out of turn, or... get in trouble for jumping up before class was even done. So... yeah. It ain't a new thing.
